name: site-nav
title: SiteNav
description: Public site navigation with an accessible mobile menu (focus trap, Escape to close). Optional mega-menu: desktop triggers open MegaMenuPanels (hover, click, ArrowDown; Escape/outside/blur close), mobile becomes a full-screen drill-down sheet (portal, focus trap, scroll lock, inert off-screen pane, actions dock). Links are real anchors so they stay crawlable.
